title: NZ MBIE Determination 2025/002 (comparative): proposed refusal, C/AS1 external-wall fire spread
jurisdiction: New Zealand (Building Act 2004); Christchurch City Council; comparative only, not Alberta

facts.text: The determination concerns an authority's proposed refusal to grant building consent for two multi-unit buildings, applying C/AS1 paragraph 5.1.1 to the proposed external wall design for control of external fire spread.
The consent application reference in the determination is BCN/2022/7604.
The plans are described as showing the buildings within 5.0 m of the relevant boundary, with fire-rated external walls proposed.
Figure 2 is a site plan showing distances to the relevant boundaries (not to scale).
Acceptable Solution C/AS1 is cited at amendment 5, effective from 5 November 2020.
